mu_name_from: _enum.h:1602 MODEL_STAFF_OF_DESTRUCTION = MODEL_STAFF + 8, loaded from Item/Staff09.bmd; OpenMU Version095d Weapons.cs:169.
why_this_one: Tarkan's drop: WebZen's item(Kor).txt flags it as a monster drop at a level Tarkan's and Blood Castle 6's monsters reach, and it was not built (the user, 2026-10-06: 'lets skip Storm Crow set, but make all others' -- the MU items in those two drop windows that were missing). Also the Zaikan's staff and the bosses' ring of eighteen (docs/tarkan-port.md).

stats.note: The item's own row from OpenMU's 0.95d initialiser; Season 6's Weapons.cs:250 agrees in every number.
stats.call_note: The 0.95d CreateWeapon: ..., magicPower 101, ..., darkWizardClass 1, darkKnightClass 0, elfClass 0, magicGladiatorClass 1.
stats.classes_from: The wizard's and the Magic Gladiator's (flags 1, 1); this game has no Gladiator.

stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:389-394: a staff that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_SCYTHE, as the Thunder and Gorgon Staves.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand.
sheet_from: Data/Item/wand10.OZJ (64x32: a cyan blade of light on black), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py; 72 triangles, one mesh. The .bmd names wand10.jpg, so the .OZJ and not the .OZT beside it.
glow_note: ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5229-5233): `case MODEL_STAFF_OF_DESTRUCTION: BlendMesh = -2; BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.2 + 0.9` -- the one mesh drawn added and breathing (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509): the whole staff is a cyan ghost, as the Staff of Resurrection is red.
material_note: No baked material: MU draws its one mesh added (see glow_note), so the staff ships as a glow part on MU's raw sheet; the islands' materials go unused.
rig_note: Staff09.rig.json from export-rig --actions=all: two bones, one action of one key, nothing moves. Kept so asset.sh does not borrow the player's rig (the trap Staff06 records). Not here: MuMain's held offset for it (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6867-6872, the bow's -10, 5, 10) and the boss's ring of eighteen flying staves (:1832, :1897; ZzzEffect.cpp:1330, MoveHandlers.cpp:4342), client effects.
